statement: Every case below is a plan. No product test, replay, store call, browser run or provider call was made by the worker. The scratch self-check recorded under contractSelfCheck is not the execution of any case and not the independent Local oracle. A planned case becoming a passing run is evidence only after a later authorized implementation and Local review.
oracleAuthorship: Declared by the worker from the contract rules and the pinned fixtures before any implementation exists. The independent Local probe must author separate assertions and may recompute the digest vectors itself; this plan is input, not its oracle.
inputOrder: Each case lists inputs before expected results. A requirement with no open item is a complete valid case; no case requires every task or requirement to cite an item id, and no case requires a count of unknowns.

proposedEnvelope.identityBasis: git blob equality at the execution base; the first sixteen names are runtime owners, the last five are existing tests; contents of the non-pinned files were hashed, not read
proposedEnvelope.sizeGuard: helper below the 700-line general source soft threshold, test below 800 lines, fixtures below 700; if the test would exceed 700 lines move fixture literals into the fixtures module rather than splitting behavior
proposedEnvelope.rollbackBoundary: Delete the three new files. Nothing imports them, no store, auth, route or data exists to undo.

frozenCurrentPacketControls.rule: The slice must not change any of them; because no existing file is edited, equality is expected by construction and is checked by git blob equality plus the unmodified legacy suites (BC-C1, BC-C2). The worker did not re-capture them.

digestVectors.canonicalForm: BRIEF_FIELD: UTF-8 bytes of the field text; DECISION: compact JSON {answer, disposition} in that key order; ITEM: compact JSON of the nine open-item keys in OPEN_ITEM_KEYS order; SHA-256 lowercase hex; JSON uses no spaces and unescaped non-ASCII
digestVectors.computedBy: worker scratch Python, not the product helper
digestVectors.state: FX-A S1 baseline (values valuesBaseline, items U1-U4 OPEN, C1 RESOLVED)
digestVectors.disposition: DECISION digests exclude needsReconfirmation by selected default (contract choice C-3); disposition is the existing review disposition value, ANSWERED in these vectors

statements: System compiles all entries into one weekly report

statements: Team leads may correct their entry until the Friday 17:00 deadline
Submitted entries are immutable once submitted
effectiveRules: Corrections before Friday 17:00 create a new entry version; after the deadline entries are immutable.

tasks.title: Mark missing, late and duplicate entries

A fixture with a missing, a late and a duplicate entry shows three visible marks.
Only the department head role can export.
A correction before the deadline creates a new entry version.
No ranking or score field exists in the report.

contractSelfCheck.what: A worker-authored scratch Python reference of the contract rules asserted that every fixture statement is an exact substring of the pinned source text, that the expected status maps above follow from the stated rules, and that the listed mutations change statuses as planned. It exercised no product code.
contractSelfCheck.limit: The same author wrote rules, fixtures and reference; agreement proves internal consistency only. Independent authorship stays with the Local probe.

valueFalsifier.claim: A deterministic evaluator over the ledger adds review value that a plain Markdown receiver route with manual review does not.

seededDefects.D8: extra BUILD-grant key with a matching binding
seededDefects.D9: omitted decision citation (known limitation; the helper must surface the item as unscoped, not hide it)

controls: CC clean FX-A ledger with no defect

arms.manual: Local reviewer inspects a Markdown rendering of the same ledgers without the helper, time-boxed
arms.helper: evaluator output on the same inputs

falsifiedIf: manual arm finds all of D1-D8 with no false positive on the controls at comparable effort
helper hides D9 instead of listing the item as unscoped
valueFalsifier.ifFalsified: choose the doc and preset route (receiver template plus manual review) and drop the helper

invariants.statement: No output asserts build readiness or an execution grant; the readout trailer is fixed and the ledger has no grant, acknowledgement or approval field.
Requirements, tasks and validations come only from the receiving author; the helper parses no prose and invents nothing; user text is quoted data.
Exact key sets, enums, id formats and bounds; any shape error yields valid:false with no readiness table; bounds never truncate.

An item blocks only requirements it applies to by citation, shared field or cited decision, and the tasks, designs and validations that depend on them; items attached to no requirement stay visible and block nothing.
Readiness never derives from the number of unknowns, a score or a percentage.
Original statements and user resolutions are carried as verbatim quotes; no field can express a winner between overlapping rules.
Candidate v1 and v2, acceptance, store, actor, routes, exporter, readiness builder and the existing review UI stay byte-identical.
Inputs precede expectations in every case; later-supplied unknowns are not demanded earlier.

independentProbeMapping.positiveControl: BC-P1 with BC-P5: a requirement with no open item stays ready and a bounded user resolution changes its dependents while the original statement survives

negativeMutationClasses.method: recompute raw SHA-256 and git blob of the 21 CVF pins and 11 mirror files against the assessment ledger and dispatch input; a changed byte must fail the comparison
remove a task or validation link in a scratch ledger
apply the constraints edit or a revision-only change to a scratch state
point a dependency at an absent task; create a two-task cycle
add a grant key or change the scope literal and recompute a matching binding

independentProbeMapping.oracleSeparation: Local assertions are written independently of this plan and run in a separate invocation; plan expectations are inputs to review only.

claimBoundary: A plan only. NOT_EXECUTED for every case. No implementation, runtime, provider, store, UI, UX, source fit, builder compliance, build-ready or live-governance claim. The envelope is proposed, not authorized. Fixtures are synthetic contract examples, not reviewed build-ready job artifacts.
